iti76:1.1: (Tik. III.) Vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttam-arahatā ti me sutaṃ.
iti76:2.1: Tīṇi-māni bhikkhave sukhāni patthayamāno sīlaṃ rakkheyya paṇḍito. Katamāni tīṇi? Pasaṃsā me āgacchatū-ti sīlaṃ rakkheyya paṇḍito, bhogā me uppajjantū-ti sīlaṃ rakkheyya paṇḍito, kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjissāmīti sīlaṃ rakkheyya paṇḍito. Imāni kho bhikkhave tīṇi sukhāni patthayamāno sīlaṃ rakkheyya paṇḍito ti. Etam-atthaṃ bhagavā avoca, tatthetaṃ iti vuccati:
iti76:3.1: Sīlaṃ rakkheyya medhāvī patthayāno tayo sukhe | pasaṃsaṃ vittalābhañca pecca sagge pamodanaṃ ||
iti76:4.1: Akaronto pi ce pāpaṃ karontam-upasevati | saṃkiyo hoti pāpasmiṃ avaṇṇo cassa rūhati ||
iti76:5.1: Yādisaṃ kurute mittaṃ yādisaṃ cupasevati | sa ve tādisako hoti sahavāso hi tādiso ||
iti76:6.1: Sevamāno sevamānaṃ samphuṭṭho samphusaṃ paraṃ | saro {diḍḍho} kalāpaṃ va alittam-upalimpati | upalepabhayā dhīro neva pāpasakhā siyā ||
iti76:7.1: Pūtimacchaṃ kusaggena yo naro upanayhati | kusā pi pūti vāyanti evaṃ bālūpasevanā ||
iti76:8.1: Tagarañca palāsena yo naro upanayhati | pattā pi surabhi vāyanti evaṃ dhīrūpasevanā ||
iti76:9.1: Tasmā palāsapuṭasseva ñatvā {sampākam}-attano | asante nupaseveyya sante seveyya paṇḍito | asanto nirayaṃ nenti santo pāpenti suggatin-ti ||
iti76:10.1: Ayam-pi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutan-ti ||7|| (Tik.
